# Which of your dependencies lack a provenance attestation?

> Paste a package-lock.json or package list to see which npm dependencies have provenance attestations and which still rely on classic publish tokens.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
